description_en: Converts images and videos uploaded by users to the card message OSS storage into resource data for unified management, and returns resource IDs that users can manage on their own
description_zh: 将用户上传到卡片短信OSS存储的图片、视频转换成（生成）资源数据统一管理，并返回资源ID，用户可以对返回的资源ID自行管理
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi get-media-resource-id --resource-type 1 --oss-key oss://alicom-fc-media/1947741454322274/alicom-fc-media/pic/202205191526575398603697152.png --file-size 12 --extend-info img_rate_:_oneToOne --memo '图片信息' --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetMediaResourceId

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

1: text.
2: image. Small images are limited to 100 KB, and large images are limited to 2 MB. Images must be clear. Supported image formats: JPG, JPEG, and PNG.
3: audio.
4: video. Supported video format: MP4.

When the resource type is image, img_rate is required.
1:1 ratio: oneToOne
16:9 ratio: sixteenToNine
3:1 ratio: threeToOne
48:65 ratio: fortyEightToSixtyFiv
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。

1：文本
2：图片。小图片限制在100 KB以内，大图片限制在2 MB以内，图片要求清晰；图片格式支持JPG、JPEG、PNG。
3：音频
4：视频。视频格式支持MP4。

资源类型为图片时img_rate必填。
1:1比例：oneToOne
16:9比例：sixteenToNine
3:1比例：threeToOne
48:65比例：fortyEightToSixtyFiv
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The extended field.

Required when the resource type is image
parameters.help_zh:
扩展字段。

资源类型为图片时必填
parameters.name: extend_info

parameters.help_en: The description of the uploaded resource
parameters.name: memo
